mentions.name: opentaint
mentions.description: This is a data-flow-based, lightweight formal verification engine for application security, positioned as "SAST++". It is deep enough to provide real formal guarantees about a codebase (zero findings is meaningful rather than a sign the tool is broken), fast enough to shift formal verification left and run on every feature during development, and expressive/customizable enough to write specs for most OWASP Top 10 vulnerability types, including broken access control and business logic flaws. It includes skills for writing specs.
mentions.problem: Existing SAST tools lack meaningful formal guarantees and are too slow to run during feature development, so verification can't be shifted left.
mentions.audience: Developers who want formal security verification applied to every feature during development, including agentic development sessions
